## Description

ND120 DGA (Decode Gate Array)
DECODE/DGA
NEC F617 - D Flip-Flop with RB, SB
ACTIVE_ASYNC=0 (default): Only async set (reset tied to VCC).
ACTIVE_ASYNC=1: Both async set and reset (original NEC behavior).
